replies.body:
Yes, seriously.

I redesigned the TeamSpeak rules to provide options for all different types of players to use different channels based on their different attitudes. I made 11 channels that are accessible by all players. Not counting the Spanish channels and music rooms, I made 7 English channels for people to talk in. Out of those, 2 are nightclub. 3 allow cursing, and 2 don't allow cursing. I feel like that is more than generous to all differing players allowing people to select what they do and don't want to hear.

If you don't like the Nightclub channel, there are 5 other channels for you to fully use, although you may also want to keep in mind that no "heavy or excessive" bullying is allowed in any channels.

I also find it funny that the Nightclub channels are the most used channels on TS, just putting that out there.

The Nightclub is a place for people to speak relatively UNCENSORED (as long as they follow the minimal rules). These rules have been here for as long as I can remember, and that has been two years.

We've agreed that the rule will be altered to "Direct racism is not allowed" (or something similar to that.)

This way people can still use the nightclub for what it was intended to be used for but now you cannot directly be racist towards others.

This will hopefully cut down on the confusion/confrontation that has spawned in the past. It will also allow users to still be free to use controversial jokes and such just as they have always been able to.

It will also make Moderating easier as the rule is now more clear.

Reauesting lock as I don't want this archived, people need to see this.
Thanks for the discussion.
